text: {"lessons":["Selling at a loss just because a stock is below my average cost is not a strategy; reassess each holding on its prospects and risk, not my purchase price.","A few trades and short-term account moves are too little evidence to show that my decisions are improving returns; keep a clear rationale and evaluate results over longer periods.","Manage the whole portfolio, including cash and position sizes, before adding to a stock; avoid letting any single trade or recent price move drive the plan."]}
